string-array.name: motivation_pool
string-array.item: SubhanAllah (Glory be to Allah)
Alhamdulillah (Praise be to Allah)
Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greatest)
La ilaha illallah (There is no god but Allah)
Astaghfirullah (I seek forgiveness from Allah)
La hawla wala quwwata illa billah (There is no power nor might except with Allah)
SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi (Glory be to Allah and His is the praise)
SubhanAllahi al-Azim (Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent)
HasbunAllahu wa ni\'mal wakil (Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs)
Allahumma salli ala Muhammad (O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad)
The best of remembrance is La ilaha illallah.
Remember Me, I will remember you. (2:152)
Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest. (13:28)
He who remembers his Lord and he who does not are like the living and the dead.
Remembrance of Allah is the greatest deed. (29:45)
The most beloved of speech to Allah are four: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, and Allahu Akbar.
Keep your tongue moist with the remembrance of Allah.
Dhikr is the polish of the hearts.
A heart without Dhikr is like a house without a dweller.
The devil is like a dog that runs away when you mention Allah.
Alhamdulillah for everything.
Trust in Allah\'s plan.
Patience is the key to paradise.
Every breath is a gift from Allah.
Seek help through patience and prayer.
Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
Be grateful and He will give you more.
Kind words are a form of charity.
The strongest among you is the one who controls his anger.
Allah is with those who are patient.
Start with Bismillah.
End with Alhamdulillah.
Dua is the weapon of the believer.
Nothing is impossible for Allah.
Focus on your own progress, not others.
May Allah guide us to the straight path.
Islam is peace.
Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is our role model.
Success comes from Allah alone.
The Quran is a healing for the hearts.
Read Quran daily, even if just one verse.
Prayer is better than sleep.
Don\'t lose hope in the mercy of Allah.
Allah hears the silent prayers of a broken heart.
Forgive others so that Allah may forgive you.
True wealth is the wealth of the soul.
A small deed done consistently is better than a large deed done once.
Be the reason someone smiles today.
Dhikr is a shield against trials.
Allah loves the consistent ones.
Purity is half of faith.
Charity does not decrease wealth.
The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.
Modesty is part of faith.
The best among you is the one who is best to his family.
Tie your camel and trust in Allah.
Actions are judged by intentions.
Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler.
Good character is the heaviest thing on the Scale.
The upper hand is better than the lower hand (giving is better than receiving).
Save yourself from the Fire even with half a date given in charity.
Righteousness is good character.
Avoid suspicion, for suspicion is the falsest of speech.
Do not envy one another.
A Muslim is a brother of another Muslim.
Allah will help His slave as long as the slave helps his brother.
Whoever follows a path in pursuit of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.
Exchange gifts, you will love one another.
Truthfulness leads to righteousness.
Control your tongue.
Make things easy and do not make them difficult.
The believer is kind and friendly.
Allah is Beautiful and He loves beauty.
Cleanliness is from faith.
Honor your guests.
Treat your neighbors with kindness.
Speak good or remain silent.
The path to Jannah is surrounded by hardships.
The path to Hell is surrounded by desires.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
Look at those below you and not those above you, so you don\'t belittle Allah\'s favors.
Worship Allah as if you see Him; if you don\'t see Him, He sees you.
Faith is composed of seventy-some branches.
The most beloved of people to Allah are those who are most beneficial to people.
Every good deed is a charity.
A believer is not bitten from the same hole twice.
The eyes do not go blind, but it is the hearts within the breasts that go blind.
Allah is enough for me.
The mercy of my Lord encompasses all things.
Paradise lies at the feet of mothers.
Contentment is an inexhaustible treasure.
Work for this life as if you will live forever, and work for the Hereafter as if you will die tomorrow.
Knowledge without action is like a tree without fruit.
The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
Your smile for your brother is charity.
Remove harmful things from the road.
Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you.
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
Master of the Day of Judgment.
You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help.
Guide us to the straight path.
Allah is One.
He neither begets nor is born.
And there is none co-equal unto Him.
Allah is the Eternal Refuge.
Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might.
Peace be upon the messengers.
And praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
